# Ranged Liquid Pump

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing)

<a href="Item-ranged-liquid-pump.md" title="Ranged Liquid Pump"><img src="icons/180.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Ranged Liquid Pump"></a>

Collects liquid source blocks within eight blocks along each axis (a 17×17×17 cube), including lava. No electricity required.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Internal fluid capacity | 10 L |
| Placement | Place from the hotbar |

## How to obtain

Combine one Pump and one Floater Rock at the Machinist’s Bench.

## Using it

See [Ranged Liquid Pump](Ranged-Liquid-Pump.md) for setup. Each source gives 10 L after two seconds of collection. Pipe it into a tank; the 10 L buffer holds one liquid at a time.
